thm:p02-tseitin (proved=annex:p2.prop.tseitin): unique extension w:V u Z_phi -> B satisfying D_phi with w(r_a)=v(phi_a) (97-103); projection claim v|=phi iff exists w with w|_V=v and w|=S_phi, unique on V u Z_phi (104-111); S_phi and T_phi equisatisfiable with phi; {T_phi}|=phi, converse need not hold (112-114)
scope of the claim: metatheoretic quantifier, input fixed on V only, uniqueness only on V u Z_phi and only for full biconditional gates

thm:p02-tseitin-size (proved=annex:p2.prop.tseitin-size): exactly M<=N auxiliary variables, at most 3M+1 clauses, at most 7M+1 literal occurrences, at most 3 literals per clause, O(N) token size and emission, bit length O(L+N log(N+1)), no linear bit-time claim, measured on the expanded primitive tree
def:p02-tseitin-root-boundary: root clause needed (phi=bottom); phi=neg P and T_phi are not logically equivalent even over the common enlarged vocabulary {P,z_eps}
